description: The bar chart, Figure 10, illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family, with error bars representing the standard deviation. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled with eight language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, listed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family is represented by a group of six bars, colored according to a legend that indicates the models mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, with the first bar (mBERT-L2) being light blue and the last bar (XLM-B2) being dark blue. The height of the bars varies across language families and models, with some bars having error bars that extend above or below the bar itself, indicating the standard deviation. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a visual representation of the effect of context masking on case tasks across different language families and models.
